features.contract: Exact-build activation, required native entry/byte checks and process-local activation of the owned presentation addon. Unsupported builds fail closed.
Shared in-run XP receipt normalization, strongest racial/fortune contribution, native choices and deferred native award bookkeeping. Preserve caller classification and rounding.

One host-owned gold wallet; native actor balances/coinage/earned counters are projections. Use the strongest racial, current Gold fortune and total permanent armory-Gold contribution instead of summing equipment across participants.
Purchased caches debit once, share price/opened count and deliver a personal native item choice to every eligible participant. Deferred banks and repeated presentation must not create extra rewards.
Native guardian rewards; no supplemental item grant is installed for 0.130. Preserve each native skill/item reward once.

Complete group pause while any relevant spell/item/cache choice or manual pause remains open. Host simulation and guest prediction stop; movement is blocked after the local player has chosen too. Picking remains possible; one `picked` event cannot resume everyone.

Allied direct heals, periodic heals and shields use player eligibility, range, missing-health/pressure rules and original-caster native coefficients/counters. Foreign periodic effects retain their producer and aura lifetime.

Foreign Thorns/Lightning Shield retaliation, Holy Nova/Holy Shock allied heals and shield/healing talent interactions preserve caster attribution, native proc cooldowns and current modifiers. Ice Barrier remains caster-only.
Hunter's Mark shares the strongest valid vulnerability and maintains native mark visuals without duplicate damage application. Owner death/leave and replacement must reconcile.

Eligible Shield Slam, Hammer of Justice and Shred hits establish persistent pursuit/basic-melee ownership. Required talents, hit success, enemy life and player GUID are checked. Special abilities retain native targeting policy.

Entering temporary immunity discards old taunts and ordinary aggro. Immune actors leave the ordinary NPC candidate pool; a fresh taunt remains possible during immunity. Candidate flags are restored after the native pass.

Resurrection Sickness: +1 stack on resurrection, -5% outgoing damage/healing per stack, cap 3; one stack recovers per 60 alive simulation seconds. Native harmful-aura name/icon, stacks and remaining time; pauses/death suspend recovery.

Sayge's Dark Fortunes: one persistent replacement buff per player, Sayge-trial replacement when ASX-28 is enabled, otherwise one roll per completed native boss encounter (not per entity), fixed category/rarity weights, bonuses rounded to whole percentage points before application and display, five-encounter scaling cap and continued endless replacements. XP/Gold use the strongest current fortune per category in coop; Luck/Pickup/Speed remain personal. Native buff tooltip and reward notification.

Exclude the four native utility trinkets (`remote`, `insignia`, `eldre_thalas`, `chosen`) from ASX reward candidates. Do not delete inventory or broadly remove other equipment/items that grant secondary stats.
Glyph gameplay intentionally disabled. Retain all nine class catalogs and shared bonus/card representations without installing glyph choices or spell mutations.

Ring enchantment kind locks on the first accepted upgrade. Five total-value tiers at native ring ranks **2/4/7/10/14**, with Minor/Lesser/unprefixed/Greater/Superior names and the five native icons. Per-ring progression, additive stats, preview/apply/improve status and no rebuild accumulation. Capped native rings may remain unenchantable or low-tier (accepted V1 limitation).

Enrich existing native party frames with missing positive buffs, compact spell/item builds and owner-correct tooltips. Keep native health/name/death/resurrection widgets; preserve native five-player capacity. Glyph/fortune/fatigue presentation must keep source identities and expire stale cosmetic data.

Native menu/Co-op decorations: participant class icons and class/character labels. Group waiting presentation names the relevant characters and separates local choice/menu from remote waiting. Shared enchantment/gem card blocks keep native gains, one native separator, a centered two-column header (32px icon beside stacked title/status), values below and compact retained-bonus hover. Glyph gameplay remains disabled.

ASX run-state isolation: reset on native run/session/clock rollback, rebind slot plus GUID, preserve authoritative native context swaps and owned pending deliveries. Solo extensions use solo identity without reading inactive coop contexts.

Native-folder installer/launcher, exact supported-client registry, normal-DLL checks, owned addon deployment, shared native-save preservation/backups, signed update/rollback, report export and uninstall/restore. No game assets or legacy custom launcher are shipped as ASX gameplay dependencies.
Upstream-native personal marks. ASX duplicate-loot gold compensation is disabled; preserve native collection and reward ownership.

One fixed personal amulet gem per actor/run. First accepted amulet locks one of eight equally likely native-icon gems; all later amulet replacements/upgrades retain it. Stable card previews, no tiers or rarity/Luck influence, native stat input restoration and no permanent save writes.

Native enemy nameplates: 70% baseline size, confirmed normal-enemy names and level labels hidden; native special-rank names preserved. Missing classification retains the original native name rather than treating an unknown NPC as ordinary. Original health updates, friendly frames and visibility preferences retained.

Outgoing enemy damage text uses one third of the fresh native size. Native direct/periodic healing amounts are attached above allies through the existing world-text queue. Unreported actual periodic HP gains are accumulated into integer cosmetic messages at most once per second per source/recipient/spell, through the native healing-log UI queue, without replaying healing or meter/proc contributions. Preserve identities and native critical animation.

One-time host initialization of distinct random native participant markers from all eight icons. Every existing mark stays reserved, already marked players are skipped, and live rechecks preserve manual changes; late joins initialize once and new runs reset observation; no solo assignment.

Optional host-owned Treasure Goblins in solo/coop: native creature creation and object transport, fleeing movement, 25 simulation-second expiry, no attacks/ordinary loot, taunt immunity, rare encounter-based appearances and personal native amulet/mark rewards. A separate launcher setting and optional contact checks preserve core ASX when disabled/unavailable.

Optional Lost Supplies: native cargo pile, map-wide placement/native-masked circular minimap icons, AS-styled fully opaque discovery notifications with instant removal, multiple 60-second reserves, six simultaneous consumable families with three encounter-based tiers, same-family renewal without stacking, twelve material variants and normalized whole-gold sales. Native temporary buff slots and stat-input restoration; host-owned cooperative scenes, identity-bound personal rolls/claims, individual hiding and shared material sales.

Optional Sayge’s Trial: native encounter trigger only between bosses, native ground rune, decorative Classic Sayge and candles, map-wide placement with flatness preference and walkable fallback/minimap pin, persistent unfinished scene with stable identity and encounter-upgraded reward, cumulative presence, bounded randomized power, automatic Fortune replacement and AS-styled progress UI visible only during native circle presence. Host-owned cooperative scene and shared progress require every active participant inside; personal Fortunes replace cooperative boss grants, with strongest XP/gold contributions preserved.
